acquisition_method.evidence: A LFQ approach in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode was applied for total cell proteomics of human fibroblasts.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: After sonication and removal of microcellular debris, proteins were reduced with 5 mM 1,4-dithiothreiotol at 55°C for 30 minutes, briefly cooled on ice, and further alkylated in the dark with 2-chloroacetamide for 15 minutes.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein content was determined with BCA, and 100 μg were digested overnight with 2 μg of Pierce MS-grade trypsin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 37°C and gentle shaking.

collision_energy.evidence: and normalized collision energy to 33%, setting first mass at m/z 100.

fragmentation_method.evidence: followed by data-dependent higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentations of maximum 18 most intense precursor ions with a charge state 2+ to 7+, using 45 seconds dynamic exclusion.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: An aliquot of samples (ca 2 μg) was injected in an UltiMate 3000 nano-UPLC online coupled to a Q Exactive HF hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
